rows.grounds: compound locative with womb and diagram sense
past passive participle agreeing with subject

items.question: By what count and in what contexts are certain beings said to undergo torment according to this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the contexts in question.
Those contexts are identified as thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings located in those contexts are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings is not specified by these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
